# MapViewState

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Create a react-map-gl MapViewState for controlling the camera.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/map-view-state",
  "type": "MapViewStateOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/map-view-state').par.longitude` (an input) and `op('/map-view-state').out.viewState` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.longitude`, `out.viewState`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

| Name | Type | Default |

| `zoom` | `NumberField` | `12` |

<!-- gen:end inputs -->
